verdict: key consistent: 72 signs = 72 letters, 20 groups = 20 words with every group length equal to its word; one letter per shape, 63 of 63 repeated occurrences. Needs two plaintext changes, both supported by the cipher: برسوم -> بمرسوم and نخيل -> بخيل. Simple substitution, one shape per letter except ع (chevron, once turned the other way).
notes: Text as enciphered: يا من له كل الموالي عبيد وبره في كل يوم يزيد / جد لي بمرسوم على عادتي بعودي الشام بخيل البريد ('grant me a decree, as is my custom, on my return to Syria with the post horses').

بمرسوم: the cipher has B M R S W M (6 signs); the master on 14r l.6 can be read بمرسوم (the record has برسوم). بخيل: the cipher's first sign is the fan (ب in عبيد, وبره, بمرسوم, بعودي, البريد), so بخيل البريد 'with the post horses', not نخيل; the dot on the master is ambiguous.
Against the record's wording (71 letters): 1 surplus sign (the م of بمرسوم) and one fan for ن; 98.4% letter, 100% skeleton.

Counts by eye: 13v l.10-13 = 11, 12, 11, 10; 14r l.1-3 = 13, 11, 5 (72). The record's 77 came from the segmenter (13v l.11 as 14 signs with 1 divider). Dividers: 20 groups, one at every word end (جدلي is enciphered as two groups, جد | لي).
